name: @dreamfactory/redjack
description: RedJack: Revenge of the Brethren (1998) — CyberFlix's last game, on DreamFactory 5. The whole game plays on the shared engine, from the first day to the end, with saved games; its machine suites play all seven days headless.
//scripts: Run from anywhere with `-w redjack`; npm sets the working directory to this package, which is why every path here is relative to it and `vite` finds the config beside this file with no --config.
